summaries.1c5751d49ad6: US authorities have warned of an ongoing threat to industrial refrigeration systems following a run of attacks on commercial freezers. The FBI, CISA and other federal bodies urged operators to unplug their controllers from the public internet, isolate them from corporate networks and patch promptly, since hackers could alter temperatures and cause fires or stock losses.
summaries.89baa9a0709a: US bank regulators from the Federal Reserve and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency contacted banks to check their systems for weaknesses after the Binance hack, a US$6.3 billion crypto theft. The outreach was prompted by fears that a crypto breach could spill into traditional finance, and some banks are reviewing their cyber defences in response.
summaries.f0bf47758311: A fresh wave of hacking has hit supermarket fridges and freezers across Europe, from Sweden to Belgium and Ireland, raising temperatures and forcing stores to bin food. The attacks echo a similar incident in France last month, and while nobody has claimed responsibility, officials fear hybrid threats to infrastructure and worry AI is making weak controllers easier to exploit.
summaries.6216779d37d1: Bunny-shaped AI plush toy My Baby Bunny was tested by the BBC and, when a journalist pressed it on sexual topics, replied with a line about not being able to help with killing the person. The incident highlights the risks of AI toys sold online with little oversight, as the BBC could not find the manufacturer.
summaries.0df97eadb291: Kotaku's Ethan Gach has rounded up three PC games free this weekend, including Payday 3 and Age of Wonders 4 on Steam until 9 November and Flotsam on the Epic Games Store until 12 November. It also flags a Humble Bundle membership this month that includes PC keys for Mafia: The Old Country and The Outer Worlds 2.
summaries.469a1443e802: A Kotaku writer shares a favourite quirk of the Ocarina of Time remake: wearing the Iron Boots during serious cutscenes makes Link's clanking footsteps audible and comical. Players have noticed the clanking survives in the remake on Switch 2, where it sounds even louder through the speakers.
summaries.9586e15c0b33: Kotaku's Rebekah Valentine offers ten tips for players new to Ocarina of Time, the 28-year-old Nintendo 64 classic, in its new remake. Advice covers doing the early tutorial, using the easier forward-tilt jump attack, exploring beyond the main path, collecting bottles and gold Skulltulas, and not attacking the Cuccos.
summaries.7fd9dc8a5ddc: Kotaku reports that the Switch 2 remake of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has removed the old trick for the Cucco minigame, where players could stash the flock to make the special birds easy to spot. The writer says other exploits, like climbing the castle drawbridge chains, have also been blocked, though some quirks remain.
summaries.05bde2c4ab3f: Logan City Council's latest news brief covers three items. Adoptable dogs will visit a Bunnings store in Bethania, a new water main at Belivah is starting construction and is due by June 2027, and the Logan Art Gallery is hosting a free opening night for six new exhibitions.
summaries.fa222037362a: Eight Logan artists and arts groups are sharing close to $40,000 in grants from a joint state and council arts fund. The money, backed by Logan City Council and the Queensland Government, is meant to help projects in music, visual arts, community arts and performance.
